{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for missing values in the biomarker_baseline column
missing_values = data['biomarker_baseline'].isnull().sum()
print("Missing values in biomarker_baseline:", missing_values)

# Check for sentinel values (e.g., -999.0) that might represent missing data
sentinel_value = -999.0
sentinel_count = (data['biomarker_baseline'] == sentinel_value).sum()
print(f"Count of sentinel value {sentinel_value}:", sentinel_count)

# Display the distribution of biomarker_baseline
print("Distribution of biomarker_baseline:")
print(data['biomarker_baseline'].describe())"}
